MMC Group

Exhibitions & Events Management Co.

Exhibitions and events are where MMC Group feels most at home. We like the pace, the moving parts, the unexpected requests — and most of all, the challenge of making everything come together smoothly.

With MMC Group, you have one team to turn to from the very first idea through to the moment the last guest leaves. We listen carefully to what you need, help you find the right venue, shape the agenda and take care of all those individual requests that can easily get lost in the middle of a big event.

And we don’t stop at the meeting itself. We can create a dedicated event website where attendees can find all the important details and share their own requirements — from flight information and transfer arrangements to pre- and post-event activities and private requests. We can also design special programmes for spouses and accompanying guests, so they can have their own experience while the main event is taking place.

Sometimes, an event needs more than good organisation. It needs an idea.

If the purpose is to launch or showcase a product, for example, we bring creativity into the picture and look for ways to make the product part of the experience itself. Our marketing capabilities, trusted technology partners and reliable suppliers help us turn those ideas into something real.

Behind the scenes, there is a lot of planning that guests may never notice — and that’s exactly how we like it. We design the logistics, build the action plans, coordinate transportation and keep a close eye on every moving part. Our network stretches across Egypt’s main entry points, cities and resorts, giving us the local reach to make things happen wherever your event takes you.

And our relationship with a corporate client doesn’t have to stop when the event is over. We can work with the company’s HR or Procurement team to create special travel benefits for their employees — from preferred hotel rates and exclusive packages to complimentary extras, special add-ons and, where available, room upgrades. These offers can be shared directly with employees through the company’s internal channels or intranet, giving them access to privileges that are normally difficult to arrange individually.

It’s a simple way for companies to give their people something extra while MMC Group takes care of the planning, logistics and travel side behind the scenes.

Expertise, creativity and logistics working in synergy. One team. One point of contact.

That’s our idea of a one-stop-shop exhibitions and events partner — MMC Group is with you from the initial concept through to the successful delivery of your event.
